summary: This screen is the main team dashboard for Nimbus, a project management platform. It gives project leads an overview of project metrics, ongoing tasks, recent project statuses, and live team activity.

stack.name: Next.js (App Router, React)
stack.why: Provides full-stack React framework with SSR, fast API routes, and seamless deployment.

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.why: Enables rapid styling matching the exact color tokens, borders, and responsive grid layouts.

stack.name: PostgreSQL via Neon
stack.why: Serverless relational database well-suited for tracking projects, tasks, user roles, and activity logs.

stack.name: Prisma ORM
stack.why: Type-safe database queries and seamless migrations across entities.

stack.name: NextAuth.js
stack.why: Zero-friction authentication handling session management, user profile avatars, and route guards.

stack.name: Vercel
stack.why: Zero-config hosting for Next.js with immediate environment integration.

steps.title: Initialize Next.js project and Tailwind CSS configuration

steps.title: Define PostgreSQL schema with Prisma
steps.detail: Model User, Project, Task, and Activity tables in prisma/schema.prisma to support dashboard queries and relationships.
steps.code:
model Project {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  ownerName String
  progress  Int      @default(0)
  status    String   // 'On track' | 'At risk' | 'Blocked'
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Activity {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  userName    String
  action      String
  targetTitle String
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}
steps.check: Run `npx prisma db push` and verify tables are synchronized on Neon database.

behaviour: Search input: typing filters recent projects and tasks dynamically or navigates to search view upon Enter.
+ Create project button: opens a modal dialog to input project name, owner, and initial deadline.
Upgrade to Pro button: redirects user to billing/Stripe checkout checkout flow.
View all link: navigates the user to the complete /projects list page.
Sidebar navigation items: route cleanly to /projects, /my-tasks, /reports, /team, and /settings.
data: Current user profile: name ('Asha K.'), initials ('AK'), subscription tier, trial expiry date.
Summary statistics: active projects count (+2 this month), tasks due this week (9 due today), completed tasks (+18% vs last week).
Recent projects: project title, owner name, integer percentage progress (0-100), and status tag ('On track' | 'At risk' | 'Blocked').
Team activity: actor name, action verb, target item title, timestamp.

backend.summary: Exposes REST endpoints to query aggregate project metrics, retrieve recent project list with completion percentages, and log user events.
backend.database: PostgreSQL managed via Neon for resilient relational querying and fast serverless connection pooling.
backend.auth: NextAuth.js session-based authentication using JWT cookies, verifying tenant access on each server action or API call.

tables.name: users
tables.columns: id uuid pk, name text, email text unique, avatar_initials text, trial_ends_at timestamp

tables.name: projects
tables.columns: id uuid pk, name text, owner_id uuid references users(id), progress integer, status text, updated_at timestamp

tables.name: activities
tables.columns: id uuid pk, user_id uuid references users(id), action_text text, target_name text, created_at timestamp

endpoints.purpose: Returns aggregate numbers for active projects, tasks due, and completed tasks.
Fetches the top most recently updated projects with their status and progress.
Fetches chronological list of team activity logs.

rules: Project progress values must be integers between 0 and 100 inclusive.
Project status values are strictly constrained to: 'On track', 'At risk', or 'Blocked'.
Only authenticated users belonging to the workspace can read dashboard stats or create projects.

pitfalls: Hardcoding progress bar percentages instead of calculating proportional width classes or CSS style widths dynamically.
Failing to truncate or wrap long project titles and team activity descriptions gracefully on narrower displays.
Ignoring color contrast ratios between badge backgrounds and badge text colors in status pills.
testing: Unit test StatCard component rendering correct values and formatting positive trend indicators in green.
Integration test verifying GET /api/dashboard returns valid HTTP 200 payload with authorized session.
Accessibility test verifying that all navigation links and buttons have valid ARIA labels or discernible text.
deploy: Provision a PostgreSQL database instance using Neon.tech free tier.
Push codebase to a GitHub repository.
Link repository with Vercel, inject DATABASE_URL and NEXTAUTH_SECRET environment variables, and trigger initial deployment.

tokens.method: Colours: pixel quantisation of the whole screenshot and of each detected element. Font sizes: text box height ÷ 1.25. Spacing: gaps between sibling boxes, snapped to a 4px grid. Measured approximations, not values read from source code.
